units.source_text: 斋宫年幼无知，她只觉得一向行期不定，如今有了日子，非常高兴。

en.t: The young Saiin knew nothing of such matters; she only felt that the departure, which had always been uncertain, now had a fixed date, and she was very pleased.

units.source_text: 母夫人伴赴伊势神宫修行之事，古无前例。

en.t: There was no precedent in ancient times for her mother to accompany her to Ise Shrine for religious purification.

units.source_text: 因此世人有讥评者，也有同情者，议论纷纷。

en.t: Because of this, some people criticized them, while others felt sympathy, and public opinion was full of debate.

units.source_text: 世间身份低微之人，万事任意作为，无人顾问，倒很自在。

en.t: People of low status in the world can do everything as they please, with no one paying attention or questioning them, so they are actually quite free.

units.source_text: 而超群拔俗之人，受人注目，行动反不自由，反多烦虑。

en.t: But those who stand above the common crowd attract people's notice, and their actions are instead constrained, leaving them with even more anxieties.
